external_pins.comment: Commits of the CTS external/ dependencies that were compiled and validated. upstream's external/fetch_sources.py declares older revisions for the same CTS tag; see UPSTREAM_CTS.md.

cases.rationale: Original upstream enumeration body exercises the result-bearing two-call idiom, VK_INCOMPLETE, returned count and untouched output tail.
Original upstream query body obtains and logs the native queue-family vector through the Vulkan instance interface.
Verifies genuine Vulkan sampler creation and destruction through ps5vk dispatch.
Compiles GLSL vertex shader at runtime via glslang and validates vkCreateShaderModule / vkDestroyShaderModule lifecycle.

Original upstream draw and pixel oracle creates an R8G8B8A8 color attachment, render pass, framebuffer and static viewport/scissor pipeline, clears and draws one triangle, copies the image to a host buffer, and compares it against the CTS reference rasterizer.
Tests single VkFence signaling via queue submit and completion wait using vkWaitForFences.
Tests multiple VkFence objects, reset, timeout, and wait-all completion behavior.
Verifies fence signaling on empty queue submission.
Original upstream test distinguishes wait-any from wait-all across two serialized submissions and validates timeout then success transitions with simultaneous command-buffer use.
Creates one fence with VK_FENCE_CREATE_SIGNALED_BIT and requires immediate signaled status and successful wait without a submission.
Repeats the original signaled-at-creation status and wait oracle over ten independent fences.
Exercises device memory suballocation, host mapping, random byte pattern read/write verification, and unmapping.

Original deterministic 257-byte full mapping flush case forces a nonCoherentAtomSize-aligned backing/range and byte-validates the mapped contents; it is API/range evidence, not a GPU visibility claim.
Original deterministic 257-byte full mapping invalidate case exercises non-coherent end-of-allocation handling and byte comparison without substituting a custom oracle.
Original deterministic subrange flush case maps allocation offset 129 and size 1025, forcing the implementation to validate and process the exact non-coherent subrange contract.
Original deterministic subrange invalidate companion validates mapped-byte preservation and invalidate behavior for the same unaligned mapping interval.
Compiles compute shader with shared variable at runtime, dispatches to GPU compute queue, and verifies SSBO output oracle.

Upstream SharedVarTest with local_size (3,2,5) and one workgroup: 30 invocations write LDS, cross it with memoryBarrierShared/barrier and read a permuted value, so the oracle only holds if every invocation observes the barrier.

Upstream SharedVarTest with local_size (3,4,1) across 42 workgroups: exercises gl_WorkGroupID/gl_NumWorkGroups addressing at full multi-group dispatch alongside the same intra-group LDS barrier oracle.

Upstream SharedVarAtomicOpTest with local_size (3,2,5) in one workgroup: every invocation must obtain a distinct atomicAdd return value on shared memory, so the SSBO permutation oracle fails if the shared atomic is not atomic.

Upstream SharedVarTest with local_size (1,1,1) across 40 workgroups: the LDS read-after-barrier oracle is applied independently per group, so a workgroup-id or per-group shared-memory aliasing defect fails the comparison.

Upstream SharedVarAtomicOpTest with local_size (3,4,1) across 42 workgroups: requires the shared atomic counter to restart per workgroup and every invocation in each of the 42 groups to receive a distinct value.

Upstream SSBOLocalBarrierTest with local_size (3,4,1) across 42 workgroups: each invocation reads back neighbour writes it did not perform, separated by memoryBarrierBuffer/barrier, so the oracle only holds if buffer writes become visible across invocations within a workgroup and stay private between workgroups.

Original SSBOBarrierTest records host-write to uniform-read, shader-write to shader-read, and shader-write to host-read buffer dependencies around two compute dispatches. The second dispatch atomically reduces data produced by the first and the upstream CPU oracle checks the exact sum.
The same original two-dispatch dependency and exact atomic-sum oracle over 385 workgroups, exercising a larger producer/consumer SSBO range without replacing the upstream shader or verifier.

Original upstream SPIR-V 1.0 case runs LocalSize 16x4x2 (128 invocations, four wave32 waves), writes a 128-element uint LDS array, crosses OpMemoryBarrier and OpControlBarrier, then byte-compares the exact reversed output.

Upstream BufferToBufferInvertTest UBO variant: reads a std140 uniform buffer through a uniform-buffer descriptor and writes the inverted 256 values to a storage buffer, so the upstream comparison covers both descriptor kinds.

The same upstream uniform-buffer case with local_size (1,4,2) over 8 workgroups: every invocation must read the uniform buffer through a distinct uniform-buffer descriptor offset and invert 1024 values.

Upstream BufferDescriptorCase bound through one vkCmdBindDescriptorSets call over two descriptor sets: storage-buffer resources live in set 0 binding 1 and set 1 binding 0 while the result buffer sits in set 0 binding 0, so the quadrant oracle fails unless a nonzero set index is bound and read correctly.
Upstream BufferViewAccessTest reads VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT through texelFetch and compares all four lanes, directly requiring Vulkan one-component completion (R,0,0,1) rather than scalar replication.

Upstream BufferDescriptorCase binds uniform buffers across two descriptor sets, records its HOST_WRITE-to-UNIFORM_READ buffer dependencies and compares four deterministic quadrant values after dispatch.
The original upstream compute test pushes one 16-byte vec4, dispatches eight invocations and byte-compares all eight SSBO vec4 results with (1,0,0,1).

The original upstream Vulkan 1.0 compute test supplies a uint32 specialization constant and a uint32 push constant, destroys the pipeline layout after command recording, dispatches 100 invocations and verifies every exact SSBO result.
Original upstream SPIR-V assembly case converts 128 signed 32-bit SSBO values to tightly packed signed 8-bit SSBO elements and byte-compares the GPU result.
Original upstream SPIR-V assembly case converts 128 unsigned 32-bit SSBO values to tightly packed unsigned 8-bit SSBO elements and byte-compares the GPU result.
Original upstream SPIR-V assembly case validates signed two-lane vector narrowing from 32-bit to packed 8-bit storage-buffer elements.
Original upstream SPIR-V assembly case validates unsigned two-lane vector narrowing from 32-bit to packed 8-bit storage-buffer elements.
Original upstream BufferBlock case converts signed scalar 32-bit SSBO elements to tightly packed signed 16-bit SSBO elements and compares the exact output.
Original upstream BufferBlock case converts unsigned scalar 32-bit SSBO elements to tightly packed unsigned 16-bit SSBO elements and compares the exact output.
Original upstream BufferBlock case validates signed two-lane vector narrowing from 32-bit to packed 16-bit SSBO elements.
Original upstream BufferBlock case validates unsigned two-lane vector narrowing from 32-bit to packed 16-bit SSBO elements.
Original upstream BufferBlock case reads tightly packed signed 16-bit SSBO elements, sign-extends them to 32-bit output and compares all 128 values.

diagnostics.rationale: Original upstream Vulkan 1.0 limit and complete-initialization oracle remains diagnostic because the truthful bounded profile does not yet satisfy the complete graphics minima.
Original upstream memory oracle remains diagnostic: the one direct-memory type is DEVICE_LOCAL and HOST_VISIBLE, but HOST_COHERENT is not advertised or established.

The original shader uses StorageBuffer8BitAccess, but the test also sets coherentMemory=true and therefore requires a HOST_COHERENT memory type. ps5vk truthfully exposes one HOST_VISIBLE non-coherent type, so the pinned upstream allocator reports NotSupported before shader execution. This is retained as a diagnostic and is not evidence against the nine storage-only shader oracles.
